items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: He, Ferde and I were three, you know, we were the arranging staff at one time.

ctx.x: But I had heard about him. But we came in contact with each other, and he wanted to do some things together, with his Deep River Orchestra.
Now, Billy Still, William Grant Still, he was one of the arrangers in the Whiteman band. He, Ferde and I were three, you know, we were the arranging staff at one time.
I guess he was one of the leading Black composers of that period.
